listing.name: VRAM Optimizer
listing.summary: A memory optimization mod that converts vanilla and modded textures into the DirectDraw Surface (DDS) format with BC7 compression.
listing.aiSummary: Converts vanilla and modded textures into BC7-compressed DDS format to reduce VRAM usage by over 75% with minimal quality loss.

description:
VRAM Optimizer

Download by clicking the banner

Be sure to follow the

README

during installation

you can support me on

What?

A memory optimization mod that converts vanilla and modded textures into the DirectDraw Surface (DDS) format with BC7 compression.

These native GPU-supported textures reduces VRAM usage by

over 75%

with practically

zero

quality loss.

You can see the different encoding options and how they look here:

Requirements & Compatibility

GPU Requirements (BC7 / DDS)

: A graphics card supporting

BC7 (Block Compression 7)

texture decompression. Practically any modern GPU from the last decade supports this natively in hardware.

Cons?

You will need to create the dds textures yourself which can take quite a while depending on your cpu speed (check README), will increase startup time a bit as well.

However

If using

fast rendering

0.8.2 or above the startup time is faster instead of slower, as FR will use the dds textures directly

Big thanks to Genir for helping with the OpenGL and Wisp for helping with the encoding

If you have any questions ask here.

aiDescription: Converts vanilla and modded textures into the DirectDraw Surface (DDS) format using BC7 compression, which is natively supported by modern GPUs. This reduces VRAM usage by over 75% while maintaining near-identical visual quality. The mod requires manual texture conversion and may increase startup time, though this is mitigated when using Fast Rendering 0.8.2 or later.
